fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) rose 7.9%, and according to UBS analysis, Q3 server CPU shipments increased 31% year-over-year with AMD maintaining 28.4% market share.
fields.summary_ko.1: UBS expects CPU sales to reach $210 billion in 2030, and if AMD maintains market share, it could record approximately $60 billion in CPU revenue.
